title: Vendor dashboard shows empty order list after pagination refactor
description: The vendor dashboard loads successfully, but the order table appears empty even when orders exist. API responses contain data, but the UI maps an incorrect response key after a pagination response shape change.
steps_to_reproduce: Login as a vendor account with existing orders
Observe table remains empty despite successful network response
error_log:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
    at VendorDashboard.tsx:118:22
expected_behavior: Order table renders items from API response
actual_behavior: UI attempts to map response.orders instead of response.data.orders
recent_changes: Refactored API layer to normalize paginated responses
